description: Customize the product page (shopify-live-horizon/templates/product.json) to match the Next.js product detail design while preserving Horizon's native gallery, variant picker, quantity selector, add-to-cart, checkout handoff, and related products. Add product detail rows (material/construction/dimensions/care/origin/story + shipping/returns) that render ONLY when real product.metafields or store policies exist — never fabricate values. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (different template file).
steps: Read context.json first, then read sections/product-information.liquid, blocks/disclosures.liquid, blocks/accordion.liquid, blocks/product-custom-property.liquid, blocks/product-description.liquid, blocks/variant-picker.liquid, blocks/buy-buttons.liquid, and src/components/product/ProductDetailView.tsx (READ ONLY) to confirm the target layout and native capabilities.

In templates/product.json, keep the `_product-media-gallery` static block with media_fit `contain` and aspect_ratio `adapt` so rug proportions are preserved (do NOT switch to a cropping ratio). Keep thumbnails/zoom as configured.

Keep the product title block as `

{{ closest.product.title }}

` and tune it to Jost display; keep the `price` block (native compare-at handling — compare-at shows only when genuinely set). Keep `variant-picker` (dynamic price/availability) and `buy-buttons` (quantity + add-to-cart + accelerated-checkout, sticky add-to-cart) intact — these preserve variant IDs, inventory, cart, and checkout handoff.

Replace or extend the existing `disclosures` block with accordion rows for Material, Construction, Dimensions, Care, Origin, and Story. Each row must render ONLY when the corresponding `product.metafields.<namespace>.<key>` is present (use `blocks/product-custom-property.liquid` which binds to a metafield, or a minimal `snippets/shukla-product-details.liquid` with `{% if product.metafields... != blank %}` guards). Do NOT hardcode metafield namespaces/values; expose the metafield reference as a merchant-editable block setting and omit rows whose data is absent. Record the chosen metafield reference approach in findings as 'needs verification during implementation'.
Add a shipping/returns disclosure row only if a real store policy / policy page exists (link to it); otherwise omit. No fabricated shipping promises.
Keep the `product-recommendations` section (related, native). Do not add recently-viewed unless Horizon already supports it trivially; if not, omit and note in findings.

If any metafield-guard logic cannot be expressed via existing block settings in JSON, create a single minimal snippet under snippets/ (e.g. snippets/shukla-product-details.liquid) referenced from a custom-liquid block — keep it reusable and merchant-safe.
acceptance_criteria: templates/product.json keeps the native media gallery (contain/adapt), variant-picker, buy-buttons (quantity + add-to-cart + accelerated-checkout), product description, and product-recommendations sections intact.

Product detail rows (material/construction/dimensions/care/origin/story/shipping) each render only when real metafields/policies exist; no hardcoded or fabricated values appear in the template or any new snippet.
Product title is Jost h1; price uses the native price block (compare-at only when set).
Running `shopify theme check` introduces zero new errors versus baseline.
templates/product.json is valid JSON after stripping its leading comment banner; any new snippet passes theme check.
verification: cd c:\Users\yashs\Downloads\shuklarugsv1\shopify-live-horizon ; shopify theme check  (no NEW errors vs baseline)
Validate product.json parses as JSON after removing the leading comment block.
Confirm variant-picker and buy-buttons blocks remain present and no metafield VALUES are hardcoded (only guarded references).
findings:
Metafield-reference approach (NEEDS VERIFICATION DURING IMPLEMENTATION): created snippets/shukla-product-details.liquid rendering accordion rows for Product story, Craft specifications (Material/Construction/Dimensions/Origin), Care & maintenance, and Shipping & returns. Each row is guarded with `!= blank` so it renders ONLY when a real value exists; no values are hardcoded and no fabricated fallbacks (unlike the Next.js reference, which uses mock defaults like 'Hand-Knotted'/'100% Wool'/'Bhadohi, India'/'12-14 Weeks' and fabricated knot stats — these were deliberately NOT copied). Chosen metafield references: namespace `custom` with keys material, construction, dimensions, care_instructions, origin_region, product_story (follows the Next.js ProductMetafields field names + common Shopify `custom` namespace convention). The exact namespace/keys MUST be confirmed against the live store's metafield definitions and adjusted in the snippet's top-of-file assigns if different; until a key resolves to a real value its row stays hidden. Merchant-editable: the snippet is invoked from a `custom-liquid` block in templates/product.json (block id shukla_product_details_dtl001), so a merchant/developer can edit namespace/keys from the theme editor's Liquid field without touching other code. Shipping & returns row links only to real configured store policy pages (shop.policies.shipping_policy / refund_policy) and is omitted entirely when no policy exists — no fabricated shipping promises. The native `disclosures` block (Shopify structured shopify.disclosure metafield) was left intact and already self-hides when empty. Recently-viewed decision: Horizon has no native recently-viewed section/block, so it was OMITTED per step 6 (not implemented) to avoid adding non-trivial custom tracking. Changes made: (1) templates/product.json — product title block switched to Jost (font var(--font-heading--family), preset h2) while keeping `

{{ closest.product.title }}

`; added custom-liquid block rendering the new snippet after the product description; preserved native _product-media-gallery (media_fit contain / aspect_ratio adapt), price block (native compare-at), variant-picker, buy-buttons (quantity + add-to-cart + accelerated-checkout), sticky add-to-cart, and the product-recommendations section unchanged. (2) Added snippets/shukla-product-details.liquid. Validation: product.json parses as valid JSON after stripping the leading comment banner. `shopify theme check` baseline = 2 errors (pre-existing UnknownFilter in blocks/disclosures.liquid and snippets/cart-disclosure-tooltip.liquid — unrelated) + 6 warnings; after = SAME 2 errors + 7 warnings. The one NEW warning is OrphanedSnippet on shukla-product-details.liquid: a known theme-check false positive because the snippet is referenced from inside a custom-liquid block's string setting (not static Liquid), which is the intended merchant-editable architecture — zero NEW errors introduced. `shopify theme dev` not booted (requires store auth) — needs verification during implementation.
